title: 12 Best Eating in San José, Costa Rica
description: Discover the 12 best places to eat in San José, Costa Rica, from authentic sodas to upscale international cuisine. Find local favorites, hidden gems, and top-rated restaurants for every budget and taste.

places.name: Restaurante Silvestre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Costa Rican Journey' tasting menu, showcasing seasonal ingredients.

places.name: Sikwa Restaurante
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their 'platos fuertes' (main dishes) featuring game meats or plantains, often served with unique indigenous grains.

places.name: Tin Jo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Dragon Roll' sushi, Pad Thai, or one of their flavorful curries.

places.name: Furca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their grilled steaks or the 'Cochinillo' (suckling pig) if available, paired with a craft cocktail.

places.name: La Casona del Cerdo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chifrijo' (rice, beans, chicharrones, pico de gallo) or their slow-roasted pork.

places.name: Grano de Oro Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Chilean Sea Bass or any of their expertly prepared meat dishes, and definitely save room for dessert.

places.name: Soda Tapia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Casado' (plate with rice, beans, choice of meat, salad, plantains) or their famous 'Gallo Pinto'.

places.name: Donde Carlos
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their cuts of 'bife' (steak) served with chimichurri, and a side of 'papas fritas'.

places.name: St. Honoré Boulangerie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flaky croissant, a savory quiche Lorraine, or one of their exquisite macarons with a cappuccino.

places.name: Mercado Central Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a 'Casado' from any well-trafficked stall, or a refreshing 'Fresco de Mora' (blackberry juice).

places.name: Arbol de Seda
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Buddha Bowl', any of the daily specials, or a fresh fruit smoothie.

places.name: Cafe Rojo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their authentic 'Pho' or a 'Banh Mi' sandwich, paired with a Vietnamese iced coffee.
